Rae (People Ops): Quick question: I booked a rental car in two countries (Belgium for 2 days, Netherlands for 1 day) for a trip next month. Any special rules about cross-border rentals and fuel receipts?
Sam (Finance): Cross-border rentals are allowed but need the rental agreement showing cross-border authorization. Fuel receipts required per company policy. If you used a toll transponder on the rental, include the toll invoice or statement.
Jon (Engineering): What about insurance add-ons the rental agency pushes? I accepted the LDW at pickup. Reimbursable?
Priya (Travel Ops): Standard insurance that covers company liability (LDW or similar) is reimbursable if pre-approved or if the company card was used. Personal upgrades (like premium vehicle category for personal comfort) are not reimbursable unless manager pre-approves.
Rae (People Ops): Currency differences — I paid fuel in EUR cash in one country, card in another. How do I record?
Sam (Finance): For cash receipts, include the local receipt and enter local_amount + USD equivalent in the expense form, with exchange_rate_source noted. For card charges, attach card statement line. We accept xe.com screenshot or provider FX rate.
Jon (Engineering): Any limits on tolls/ferry charges? I had to take a short ferry between mainland and island.
Priya (Travel Ops): Ferry and tolls for business routing are reimbursable. Keep receipts. If ferry is optional for a personal scenic route, that's not reimbursable.
Rae (People Ops): Lost fuel receipt — can I use a photo from the station showing pump total?
Sam (Finance): If no official receipt, submit a Lost Receipt Affidavit plus any backup (photo of pump, bank charge, or map showing station). Manager sign-off required for affidavit.
ExpenseBot: Reminder: include these fields on the expense: date, merchant, local_amount (currency), usd_equivalent, exchange_rate_source, receipt_upload(s), rental_agreement_upload.
Rae (People Ops): Thanks — will attach rental agreement and mixed receipts. One more: parking tickets? got one in Amsterdam, is that reimbursable?
Sam (Finance): Parking tickets/traffic fines are NOT reimbursable. If you dispute it and get a refund, attach proof.
Rae (People Ops): Great, thanks everyone. Will file within 30 days and tag Sam if anything needs manual review.
Priya (Travel Ops): Ping travel-ops if you want us to book the car next time — we have corporate rates that include cross-border coverage sometimes.
